ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { correlationId: attributes.headers['x-correlation-id'] default correlationId default uuid(), orderId: payload.orderId, customerId: payload.customerId, rawPayload: payload, sagaType: p('saga.type') default "ORDER_FULFILMENT" }

db:select.doc:name: Check Existing Saga
db:select.db:sql: SELECT saga_id, saga_state FROM saga_instances WHERE order_id = :orderId AND saga_type = :sagaType

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sagaId: vars.existingSaga[0].saga_id, orderId: vars.tx.orderId, sagaState: vars.existingSaga[0].saga_state, statusUrl: p('http.basePath') ++ "/sagas/" ++ vars.existingSaga[0].saga_id, correlationId: vars.tx.correlationId }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert saga_instance
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO saga_instances ( saga_id, saga_type, order_id, customer_id, request_payload, saga_state, current_step, state_version, correlation_id, started_at ) VALUES ( :sagaId, :sagaType, :orderId, :custId, :reqPayload, 'STEP_IN_PROGRESS', 1, 1, :corrId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ 'sagaId': vars.sagaInit.sagaId, 'sagaType': vars.tx.sagaType, 'orderId': vars.tx.orderId, 'custId': vars.tx.customerId, 'reqPayload': write(vars.tx.rawPayload, 'application/json'), 'corrId': vars.tx.correlationId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert saga_steps
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO saga_steps (step_id, saga_id, step_sequence, step_name, step_state, compensation_state) VALUES (:s1, :sagaId, 1, 'RESERVE_INVENTORY', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'NOT_REQUIRED'), (:s2, :sagaId, 2, 'CHARGE_PAYMENT', 'NOT_STARTED', 'NOT_REQUIRED'), (:s3, :sagaId, 3, 'DISPATCH_SHIPPING', 'NOT_STARTED', 'NOT_REQUIRED')

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sagaId: vars.sagaInit.sagaId, orderId: vars.tx.orderId, sagaState: "STARTED", statusUrl: p('http.basePath') ++ "/sagas/" ++ vars.sagaInit.sagaId, correlationId: vars.tx.correlationId }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var rep = if (payload is Binary or payload is String) read(payload, 'application/json') else payload --- { ackId: attributes.ackId, reply: rep, sagaId: rep.sagaId, stepId: rep.stepId, outcome: rep.outcome default "FAILURE", result: rep.result default {}, failureCode: rep.failureCode default "RESERVATION_FAILED", failureMessage: rep.failureMessage default "Inventory unavailable" }

db:update.doc:name: Complete Step 1

db:select.doc:name: Read Request Payload
db:select.db:sql: SELECT request_payload, order_id, correlation_id FROM saga_instances WHERE saga_id = :sagaId

db:update.doc:name: Start Step 2
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_steps SET step_state = 'IN_PROGRESS', command_sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE step_id = :s2

amqp:message.amqp:body: #[write({ sagaId: vars.replyTx.sagaId, stepId: vars.replyTx.sagaId ++ '-STEP-2', orderId: vars.sagaRecord[0].order_id, amount: vars.sagaReq.totalAmount, currency: vars.sagaReq.currency, cardToken: vars.sagaReq.payment.cardToken }, "application/json")]

db:update.doc:name: Abort Saga
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_steps SET step_state = 'FAILED', failure_code = :fCode WHERE step_id = :stepId; UPDATE saga_instances SET saga_state = 'ABORTED', failure_code = :fCode, failure_message = :fMsg, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE saga_id = :sagaId;

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var rep = if (payload is Binary or payload is String) read(payload, 'application/json') else payload --- { ackId: attributes.ackId, reply: rep, sagaId: rep.sagaId, stepId: rep.stepId, outcome: rep.outcome default "FAILURE", result: rep.result default {}, failureCode: rep.failureCode default "PAYMENT_FAILED", failureMessage: rep.failureMessage default "Payment authorization declined" }

db:update.doc:name: Complete Step 2

db:select.doc:name: Read Request Payload
db:select.db:sql: SELECT request_payload, order_id, correlation_id FROM saga_instances WHERE saga_id = :sagaId

db:update.doc:name: Start Step 3

amqp:message.amqp:body: #[write({ sagaId: vars.replyTx.sagaId, stepId: vars.replyTx.sagaId ++ '-STEP-3', orderId: vars.sagaRecord[0].order_id, recipientAddress: vars.sagaReq.shipping, serviceLevel: vars.sagaReq.shipping.serviceLevel }, "application/json")]

db:update.doc:name: Mark Compensating
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_steps SET step_state = 'FAILED', failure_code = :fCode WHERE step_id = :stepId; UPDATE saga_instances SET saga_state = 'COMPENSATING', failure_code = :fCode, failure_message = :fMsg WHERE saga_id = :sagaId;

db:select.doc:name: Read Step 1 Reservation
db:select.db:sql: SELECT result_payload FROM saga_steps WHERE saga_id = :sagaId AND step_sequence = 1

db:update.doc:name: Mark Compensated
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_steps SET compensation_state = 'COMPENSATED', compensated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE saga_id = :sagaId AND step_sequence = 1; UPDATE saga_instances SET saga_state = 'COMPENSATED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE saga_id = :sagaId;

db:select.doc:name: Read Step 2 Payment
db:select.db:sql: SELECT result_payload FROM saga_steps WHERE saga_id = :sagaId AND step_sequence = 2

db:select.db:sql: SELECT result_payload FROM saga_steps WHERE saga_id = :sagaId AND step_sequence = 1

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE saga_steps SET compensation_state = 'COMPENSATED', compensated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE saga_id = :sagaId AND step_sequence IN (1, 2); UPDATE saga_instances SET saga_state = 'COMPENSATED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE saga_id = :sagaId;

db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM saga_steps WHERE saga_id = :sagaId ORDER BY step_sequence ASC

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var header = vars.sagaHeader[0] fun formatTimestamp(ts) = if (isEmpty(ts)) null else (ts as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}) ++ "Z" --- { sagaId: header.saga_id, orderId: header.order_id, sagaState: header.saga_state, startedAt: formatTimestamp(header.started_at), completedAt: formatTimestamp(header.completed_at), failureCode: header.failure_code, failureMessage: header.failure_message, steps: vars.sagaSteps default [] map (s) -> { stepSequence: s.step_sequence, stepName: s.step_name, stepState: s.step_state, attemptCount: s.attempt_count, result: if (!isEmpty(s.result_payload)) read(s.result_payload, "application/json") else null, compensationState: s.compensation_state, compensatedAt: formatTimestamp(s.compensated_at), failureCode: s.failure_code }, correlationId: header.correlation_id }
